coreIdea: Take the BTC 15m leg whose order book shows stronger bid-depth support (top-N cumulative depth ratio differential between the legs) with one FOK taker buy and hold to fee-free redemption, re-testing the measured book-imbalance gross edge under a single taker fee.

experiments.hypothesis: Buying the leg with the higher top-of-book bid-depth ratio (differential >= minImbalance) and holding to fee-free redemption captures the measured book-imbalance gross taker edge (+$0.056/mkt, net ~$0 at round-trip fees) at roughly half the fee drag, netting positive.
experiments.successCriteria: Best cell netEvPerMarket > 0 at stage-1 coverage (STAGE-GATES.md gate 1).

passes.note: All cells net-positive: 0.1 → +0.48 (run 256, 879/1000 played, 1027 trades, 54.84% win), 0.2 → +0.31 (run 253), 0.3 → +0.24 (run 254), 0.4 → +0.40 (run 255). Non-monotonic, and participation is nearly flat (879→858) — the threshold barely binds in this range; cell spread is mostly entry-timing jitter. 0.1 best and stable across halves (last-500 +0.53 vs all +0.48), 8/11 live days positive, both weeks positive.

Signal lives at the touch: 1 → +0.51 (run 260, 878/1000, 55.24% win, 2 neg days), 3 → +0.48 (run 257, exact replica of run 256 — determinism check passed), 5 → +0.05 (run 258), 10 → -0.07 (run 259). Plateau at levels 1-3, collapse beyond — deeper cumulative depth dilutes the informative liquidity near the touch.

Plateau at 0.7-0.9: 0.7 → +0.58 (run 261, last500 +0.40), 0.8 → +0.51 (run 262, last500 +0.46), 0.9 → +0.54 (run 263, last500 +0.47); 0.6 collapses to +0.21 (run 264, last500 -0.13, 46.01% win). Participation identical (878/1000 everywhere) — the cap shifts entry timing, not selection. 0.8 picked as plateau center with most balanced halves; 0.7/0.9 within noise.

ISOLATED SPIKE, not a plateau: 0 → -0.63 (run 268, 48.11% win), 60 → +0.51 (run 265, 55.24% win), 180 → -0.17 (run 266, 46.17% win), 420 → -0.65 (run 267, 31.58% win). The whole edge lives at the 60s entry; both neighbors are negative. Win-rate gap 60s-vs-180s (55.24 vs 46.17 on ~875 mkts) is ~5σ — real in this window, but fragile-timing advisory for the gate. 420s at 31.58% win: late-window imbalance ANTI-predicts under taker-buy — roadmap #5 (late-window) is measured hostile as stated; a reverse-signal variant is the testable version.

Flat per-share — exposure knob, not edge: 10 → +0.24 (run 271, 2.4¢/share), 20 → +0.51 (run 269, 2.55¢/share), 40 → +1.03 (run 270, 2.57¢/share, 55.34% win, slight FOK-kill uptick: 871 vs 878 played). No capacity wall up to 40 shares. Kept 20 (default) — argmaxing exposure is leverage, not signal; stop spending passes here.

Flat — param doesn't matter: 0.01 → +0.46 (run 274, 856/1000 played), 0.02 → +0.51 (run 272, 878/1000), 0.04 → +0.47 (run 273, 890/1000). Tolerance trades a few FOK kills for a few worse fills; EV within noise. Kept 0.02.

refine.note: Oscillating, not a pocket: 30 → +0.52 (run 278, 55.25% win), 45 → -0.11 (run 275, 51.03%), 60 → +0.51 (run 265, 55.24%), 90 → +0.17 (run 276, 52.05%), 120 → -0.13 (run 277, 49.1%). Adjacent swings each ~1.8σ — consistent with a noisy hill over 30-90s (neighborhood mean ≈ +0.27), not a stable +0.5 plateau. Kept startSec=60 (30 is +0.01 within noise; all judged passes used 60). Advisory: best-cell +0.51 likely overstates out-of-sample edge.

gateLog.note: Best cell netEv +0.51/mkt at 1000 mkts (run 265: imbLevels=1, minImbalance=0.1, size=20, startSec=60, maxEntryPrice=0.8, slippageTol=0.02; 878/1000 played, 1023 taker trades, 55.24% win, fees $110.3, gross ≈ +0.62/mkt) — gate 1 criterion netEvPerMarket > 0 met. Advisories (non-blocking): startSec response oscillates (45s → -0.11 while 30/60 → +0.5); coverage is a single 11-day June 2026 window; minImbalance barely binds so the entry is effectively 'first tick after 60s'. Extending run 265 to 3000 markets.

netEv -0.22/mkt at 3000 mkts (run 265 extended: 2861/3000 played, 3307 trades, 51% win, fees $358.0, gross ≈ -0.10/mkt) — gate 2 criterion netEvPerMarket > 0 FAILED. Every pre-June week negative (W20 -0.41, W21 -0.65, W22 -0.10, W23 -0.29); only W24 positive (+0.33, 54.09% win) — the stage-1 edge was one strong week. Gross negative at 3000: not fee-bound at these params; the signal itself carries no edge over May 2026.

outcome.reason: successCriteria 'Best cell netEvPerMarket > 0 at stage-1 coverage (STAGE-GATES.md gate 1)' met: best cell +0.51 net/mkt at 1000 (run 265, 878 played, 55.24% win); stage-2 extension to 3000 collapsed to -0.22 net / -0.10 gross with all pre-June weeks negative (W20-W23: -0.41/-0.65/-0.10/-0.29), edge confined to week W24.

experiments.hypothesis: Requiring the depth-imbalance differential to hold continuously toward one side for persistSec seconds before the taker entry rejects one-print book flickers; sustained resting-book pressure carries directional information that the baseline's instantaneous read (measured gross -0.10/mkt at 3000 markets) does not.
experiments.successCriteria: Best cell netEvPerMarket > 0 at stage-1 coverage (STAGE-GATES.md gate 1) AND the persistence filter binds: best cell markets played strictly below the champion's 878/1000 at the same coverage.

passes.note: No positive cell — hypothesis falsified at pass 1. 5 → -0.07 (run 283, 878/1000 played — barely binds, 49.66% win), 15 → -0.09 (run 280, 493/1000, 21.7% win, avgLose -2.75), 30 → -0.02 (run 281, 163/1000, 10.43% win, avgLose -1.22), 60 → +0.00 (run 282, 35/1000, 11.43% win, avgLose -1.05, thin). The filter BINDS (878→35) but payoff shape shows what survives: win% falls to ≈ entry price and avgLose shrinks toward -$1 — persistent one-sided pressure selects cheap losing-leg (longshot) book geometry, fairly priced, EV ≈ 0 minus fees. best=60 is the literal argmax but moot on 35 markets. Planned p2-startSec and p3-minImbalance not submitted: both tune a mechanism pass 1 measured dead (timing/threshold cannot fix longshot selection).

gateLog.note: No cell netEvPerMarket > 0 at 1000 mkts: -0.07 / -0.09 / -0.02 / +0.00 (runs 283/280/281/282). Best cell (persistSec=60, run 282) is +0.00 net (pnl +2.54, fees $1.13, gross +0.0037/mkt) on 35 played, 39 trades — thin and not positive. Gate 1 criterion failed; binding filter selects EV-neutral longshots (win% 10-22% ≈ entry price).

outcome.reason: successCriteria 'Best cell netEvPerMarket > 0 at stage-1 coverage (STAGE-GATES.md gate 1) AND the persistence filter binds: best cell markets played strictly below the champion's 878/1000 at the same coverage' not met: the filter binds (35-493 played) but no cell is net-positive (-0.09 to +0.00); persistent pressure selects EV-neutral longshot books (win% 10.43-21.7 ≈ entry price, avgLose -1.05 to -2.75).

experiments.hypothesis: A rapid change in the depth-imbalance differential within flowWindowSec (depth being added to one leg's bids / pulled from its asks) marks informed action before it is fully priced; buying the leg the book is turning toward captures direction that the static level (measured gross -0.10/mkt at 3000) and the persistent level (measured EV-neutral longshot selection) do not.
experiments.successCriteria: Best cell netEvPerMarket > 0 at stage-1 coverage (STAGE-GATES.md gate 1) AND the flow trigger binds: best cell markets played strictly below the champion's 878/1000 at the same coverage.

passes.note: Flat-negative and does NOT bind: 0.15 → -0.38 (run 288, 878/1000 played, 48.18% win), 0.3 → -0.43 (run 285, 882/1000), 0.45 → -0.46 (run 286, 876/1000), 0.6 → -0.47 (run 287, 874/1000, 47.71% win). Participation ≈ baseline's 878 at every threshold — the level-1 differential swings past 0.6 within 30s in virtually every market, so the touch-level derivative is flicker, not flow; entering on it wins 48% (worse than the level signal). best=0.3 (default) is moot; appending an imbLevels pass — the derivative is only a measurement at an aperture stable enough that a swing means real order flow.
